## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector performance (Tech, Materials, Financials positive vs Consumer Discretionary, Energy, Utilities weak) and major megacap divergence (AAPL RECOVERY vs MSFT/NVDA ABOVE TREND); Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors, tech-heavy).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +29.05%) ABOVE TREND. Materials next: FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND. Financials: JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary lagging: NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, LOW (1W: -4.88% | 1M: -4.15%) BELOW TREND. Energy weak: XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION, OXY (1W: -3.82% | 1M: +5.60%) CORRECTION. Utilities and Real Estate also showing weakness across names.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +26.25%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +21.87%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +29.05%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5; tech-heavy), so gains are concentrated rather than broad.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: OXY (1W: -3.82% | 1M: +5.60%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION, COP (1W: -3.98% | 1M: +10.44%) CORRECTION, NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy and Consumer Discretionary.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +26.25%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: multiple large caps (AAPL RECOVERY, GOOGL CORRECTION, UNH RECOVERY, XOM CORRECTION) show 1W vs 1M mismatch — treat as a tactical environment, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is mixed but leading on the week; MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.05% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth positive within the 5/11 context; watch for concentration risk as gains are concentrated in a handful of large names.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are constructive: JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +5.04%) ABOVE TREND — steady participation supports risk tilt toward cyclicals if confirmed.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is mixed/soft: LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -6.07%) RECOVERY; headlines are bullish for several names but price action is uneven — monitor news-driven dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and selected Materials/Tech names showing ABOVE TREND (JPM, V, FCX, MSFT, NVDA); reduce exposure to Consumer Discretionary and lagging Energy names (NKE, LOW, XOM) until trend clarity returns. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — stay selective and heed the major megacap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.71% | 1M: +13.41%) and Materials (1W: +1.69% | 1M: +6.61%) — watch breadth concentration. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -2.99%) and Utilities (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -3.35%) as downside pressure persists.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA continuation above recent 1W highs would confirm tech leadership and keep NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL holding the 1W bounce (AAPL (1W: +1.05% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY) would signal stabilization; JPM sustaining ABOVE TREND momentum (JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND) would support a tilt toward cyclicals.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+55): Boeing (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND — bullish contract headline but price is below trend, divergence to monitor. HD (+50): Home Depot (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -2.86%) BELOW TREND — positive narrative but price not confirming, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NKE (-60): Nike (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm downside. INTU (-45): Intuit (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines align with short-term weakness despite positive 1M, watch for further 1W deterioration. GOOGL (-45): Alphabet (1W: -0.01% | 1M: +1.17%) CORRECTION — regulatory headlines weigh; price already showing short-term fatigue.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; style mixed / no clear leadership.  
MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND showing strength.  
Key risk: major divergence across megacaps (AAPL RECOVERY, GOOGL CORRECTION, UNH RECOVERY) and several bullish headlines (BA, HD) are not yet confirmed by price — watch for trend breaks.
